'''Baby Dinosaur Skeletons''' are [[monster]]s summoned during the [[Osseous]] boss encounter. Six are summoned when Osseous slams her tail against the ground, and then will walk towards her. When they reach Osseous, they will heal her for a small portion of their remaining life points. Osseous will then swipe her tail, knocking them back, causing them to become aggressive towards the player. Their melee attacks can apply a short stun.

They don't have the same resilience to non-[[necromancy]] attacks that Osseous does. When killed, they don't drop any [[items]].
